changelog: 1.1.2 (Jellyfin 12.2 to 12.4): calibration no longer runs out of memory on larger servers — each case keeps only what that account's ranking reads, and the calibration caches have a size limit (measured on a MovieLens server: peak memory 4.3 GB → 1.2 GB, 54 → 13 minutes, same result). The options of the settings level selector are readable again when the list is open. Security: the Seerr API key and the Gotify token are no longer sent along when Seerr or the webhook answer with a redirect (the error now names the address to save instead), and Seerr answers are size-limited.
